_about: Area-of-interest ETL piece. Turns a polygon source (inline GeoJSON, a 'minx miny maxx maxy' box, or the output of a boundary piece) into the single-polygon GeoJSON a model reads as its AOI input. Runs as an input-side task ahead of the model in a composite run (see model_task.input_steps).

transform_specs.name: aoi-from-boundary
transform_specs.description: Normalize a polygon source (GeoJSON geometry/feature/collection, a bounding box, or a boundary piece's output) into one (Multi)Polygon FeatureCollection in EPSG:4326, with optional buffer, simplify, dissolve and bbox-only. Hard-fails when the bounding box exceeds max_area_km2.

dissolve.description: Union all polygons into one feature.

bbox_only.description: Replace the geometry with its bounding box.

max_area_km2.description: Fail when the AOI bounding box is larger than this (km2).
